title: Easy Flow
tagline: The project combines a modern user interface with an AI agent to enable users to do DeFi actions
description: The goal of the project is to ease new user's on boarding on Flow ! Our AI agent can abstract the complex part of DeFi action to allow new user to focus on what they want to do rather than how to do it. With the natural speach we allow to communicate easily with the agent to allow new user that are not familiar with the blockchain to use it
how_its_made:
Made with <3
The front end uses Next.
The back-end is made with JS and Express and is pretty generic.
Our Agent is made with Uagent and GPT4omini to be both easy to use and reliable.
We use the gpt 4o model.
It is worth mentionning that we spent a lot of time working on the extensions
